summary: Full backend+frontend smoke testing of imported SMA NEGERI 1 LAGUBOTI app. All 36 pytest cases passed (public endpoints, auth protection, 22 authenticated GET endpoints, forgot-password, AI summary endpoint). Frontend login works end-to-end with seeded super admin; dashboard loads; navigation to Classes, Attendance, Announcements, Library, Settings, SchoolInfo, OrgStructure succeeds without runtime errors. Public pages /profil-sekolah, /struktur-organisasi, /galeri, /ppdb, /presentasi all render.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~4000 lines in a single file; consider splitting into routers/modules for maintainability (not blocking).
PpdbPublic form uses browser default date picker (mm/dd/yyyy); replace with locale-aware or shadcn calendar for Indonesian audience.
Public /ppdb page sends many 401 requests (likely global axios interceptor hitting authenticated endpoints while unauthenticated). Harmless but noisy — gate those calls behind auth state.
seed_data_creation: None persistent; AI test creates+deletes a TEST_AI book.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend routes are mounted under '/' with Protected layout; dashboard path is '/' (not '/dashboard'). Public routes: /profil-sekolah, /struktur-organisasi, /galeri, /ppdb, /presentasi, /dokumentasi, /forgot-password, /reset-password. Backend uses /api prefix with router name 'api'. All endpoints tested work. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is configured and the AI book-summary endpoint no longer returns 'Fitur AI belum aktif'.
